## 1. Professional Identity & Biography
Thimathi Dissanayake (also known professionally as Thimathi Manahara) is a Sri Lanka-based technologist operating across software engineering, enterprise data engineering, UI/UX systems design, and multimodal artificial intelligence research.

He maintains two active industry appointments:
1. Data Engineer at CreativeX Technology (Pvt) Ltd
2. Product Designer at NONO AI

His philosophy balances engineering rigor, relational data integrity, clean architecture, and human-centered design.

## 4. Key Engineering Projects
### Baby Mine — Maternal & Early Childhood Support Platform
- URL: https://www.thimathi.online/projects/baby-mine
- Architecture:
  - Frontend: React Native (Cross-Platform iOS & Android), Redux Toolkit, React Native SVG
  - Backend: Supabase Backend Infrastructure, PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security (RLS)
  - Admin: React.js, Material UI, Chart.js, Supabase Functions
- Scope: Comprehensive guidance and pediatric growth metric tracking spanning prenatal stages through the first four years of a child's life.

### Aurevia — Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Framework
- URL: https://www.thimathi.online/projects/aurevia
- Architecture:
  - Text Processing: Fine-tuned BERT Transformer Pipeline (78% classification accuracy)
  - Speech Processing: CNN Architecture on acoustic spectrogram representations (83% classification accuracy)
  - Multimodal Fusion: Late fusion dense neural network (85% classification accuracy across RAVDESS, TESS, and GoEmotions benchmarks)
  - Backend: FastAPI, PyTorch, Supabase PostgreSQL
- Research Output: Prepared as lead author academic submission for the 7th CINEC International Research Symposium (CIRS 2026).
- Scope & Ethics Note: Affective computing research prototype exploring emotional well-being and burnout markers; not intended as a medical diagnostic device.
